headword: {火災報知器|かさいほうちき}

definitions.explanation: A device that detects fire or smoke and sounds an alarm. Required by law in residential buildings in Japan.

examples.japanese: {火災報知器|かさいほうちき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
⟦{各部屋|かくへや}→各部屋：27608_kakuheya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{火災報知器|かさいほうちき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧。
examples.english: Install fire detectors in each room.

examples.japanese: {火災報知器|かさいほうちき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}ったら→鳴る：01143_naru⟧、⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いて→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}して→避難する：26827_hinansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If the fire alarm goes off, please evacuate calmly.

notes:
A device that detects fire or smoke and triggers an alarm. In Japan, residential installation has been mandatory since 2011.

FORMS:
⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧ (fire/conflagration) + {報知|ほうち} (notification) + {器|き} (device)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火災報知器|かさいほうちき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: fire alarm sounds
- {火災報知器|かさいほうちき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: install a fire alarm
- {火災報知器|かさいほうちき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧: fire alarm inspection
- {火災報知器|かさいほうちき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧: battery replacement for fire alarm

TYPES:
- ⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧{感知器|かんちき}: smoke detector
- ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧{感知器|かんちき}: heat detector

Also called ⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧{報知機|ほうちき} (with ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ instead of {器|き}); both kanji are used.
